leaves.name: sga7_IX_3_3_SHpre
leaves.doc: dict-models, printed form: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, Prop. 3.3, second assertion, over strictly henselian traits, with U the print's N0 x_S S' (the preimage of N0 under the projection N x_O O' -> N), not the identity component of N x_O O' (number UNVERIFIED). With sga3_VIB_3_10 and geomConnOfRationalPoint (idComp_baseChange, SGA 3 VI_B 3.3 proved) replaces sga7_IX_3_3_SH.
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED: SGA 7 IX 3.3 may assume an algebraically closed residue field (then the print is the restriction to such O, as for sga7_IX_3_3_SH)
leaves.source: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, Prop. 3.3, second assertion (N0 x_S S' = N'0 for semistable reduction), over strictly henselian traits, U = pullback.fst^-1(N0) as printed (number UNVERIFIED); dict-models

leaves.name: raynaudSemistableSHOr
leaves.doc: dict-models, printed form under either reading of 'semistable': Raynaud's criterion, SGA 7 I Exp. IX Prop. 4.7 (number UNVERIFIED) over a strictly henselian DVR, with the conclusion the disjunction of semistability over k(s) (general torus) and on the geometric special fibre. With geomConnOfRationalPoint (the k(s) -> kbar ascent is proved) replaces raynaudSemistableSH.
leaves.flag: reading risk: the print may assume an algebraically closed residue field or require m > 3 (locators.md R6); the k(s)/kbar reading of 'semistable' is covered by the disjunction
leaves.source: SGA 7 I Exp. IX Prop. 4.7 (Raynaud's criterion) over a strictly henselian DVR: m >= 3 invertible and A[m] rational imply semistable reduction, read over k(s) or over kbar (number UNVERIFIED); dict-models

leaves.name: mumfordGroupLawConn
leaves.doc: dict-models, printed form: Mumford-Fogarty-Kirwan, GIT, Thm 6.14 over a connected locally noetherian base (numbers UNVERIFIED): the group law on a proper smooth family with a section all of whose fibres are abelian varieties. The gluing over connected components is proved (mumfordGroupLaw_of_conn). Replaces mumfordGroupLaw.
leaves.source: Mumford-Fogarty-Kirwan, Geometric Invariant Theory, Thm 6.14 (S connected locally noetherian, F -> S smooth proper with a section e, a fibre an abelian variety: F is an abelian scheme with identity e); numbers UNVERIFIED; dict-models

leaves.name: blr_7_2_1
leaves.doc: dict-models, printed form: Bosch-Lutkebohmert-Raynaud, Neron models, 7.2 Thm 1 (numbers and hypotheses UNVERIFIED): Neron models commute with base change along an extension of DVRs of ramification index 1 with separable residue extension (here K'/K separable algebraic, A an abelian variety: specializations). The specialization to strictly henselian O1 is the old field, with no pinning of O^sh (EGA IV 18.8.8 not needed). Replaces neronBaseChangeStrictHenselization.
leaves.flag: reading risk: if BLR 7.2 Thm 1 is printed only for etale maps, strict henselization and completion, this form exceeds it (reduct-glue section 5); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Bosch-Lutkebohmert-Raynaud, Neron models, 7.2 Thm 1: Neron models commute with ramification-index-1 base change with separable residue extension (locator UNVERIFIED); dict-models
